name: tell-me
description: Tell Me: a habit tracker built around one question — did you show up? Web app + iPhone app (web/) and the push-reminder service (api/).

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/app.e2e.mjs && node e2e/native.e2e.mjs && node e2e/push-flow.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
